Appointment application of the municipality of Rotterdam. People can make appointments for many of the services offered by Rotterdam. They can choose their preferred location and an available time slot at that location.

There is also a section for Rotterdam employees so they can create and manage appointments for people, and can configure the products, locations and which product is available at which location.

Emma - Language Learning App

Learn Languages With Emma is a language learning platform for children aged 2–7. The web application allows parents, teachers, speech therapists, and schools to monitor children’s learning progress while they practice vocabulary through educational games on the mobile app. The platform supports eight languages and includes detailed reports on vocabulary development, reading, and listening skills.

The dashboard (shown below) provides an overview of completed tests, activity history, scores, and progress per child. The application is built with Apache Wicket 10, which has been an excellent fit for building a component-oriented, stateful web application with reusable UI components and complex forms.

Website: https://www.teachkidslanguages.com
